item.title: Convex Optimization
item.description: This notebook records my study of convex optimization during graduate school. Convex Sets and Cones From lines to line segments Definition 1 (Affine Set, 仿射集). A set $C\subseteq\mathbb R^n$ is affine if, for any $x_1,x_2\in C$ and $\theta\in\mathbb R$, $$ \theta x_1+(1-\theta)x_2\in C. $$ Allowing every real $\theta$ means that the entire line through $x_1$ and $x_2$ lies in $C$.
